title: Malkan divergence on timeframe-break trades: exit on divergence, and reverse divergence (PRD/NRD) on the lower TF as an entry filter

what.name: Trades
what.value_plain: tf_break events, BTCUSDT 15m / 1h / 4h, entry at the next open, fixed exit 4 bars later (exit study: held to the first divergence against the trade, max 24 / 24 / 12 bars)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Divergence detector
what.value_plain: regular 3-10 bars; reverse (PRD / NRD) 5-14 bars with RSI >= 60 / <= 40
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Entry filter
what.value_plain: reverse divergence WITH the trade (PRD long, NRD short) on the lower TF known in the last 10 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: CVD divergence
what.value_plain: cumulative taker delta in place of RSI (regular kinds only)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10 % round trip (taker both legs), no slippage, no funding
what.label: OURS

how: Step 1, exploratory on DEV 2022-01..2024-06: every divergence kind x source x timeframe, at entry and as exit (about 66 cells). Step 2: the one consistent cell frozen in PRE_REG_DIV.md and run once on 2020-2021, week-block bootstrap, Holm over 3 timeframes.
window: DEV 2022-01..2024-06 (exploratory); fresh check 2020-01..2021-12; VALIDATION and HOLDOUT not read
why: 2020-2021 (never seen): 15m flagged trades -0.110 % per trade (n 274), Holm p 1.00 -> FAIL
2020-2021 (never seen): 1h flagged trades -0.180 % per trade (n 131), Holm p 1.00 -> FAIL
2020-2021 (never seen): 4h flagged trades -0.384 % per trade (n 52), Holm p 1.00 -> FAIL
Flagged trades did no better than the rest on 2020-2021; the DEV lead (best of about 66 cells) was chance.
Exit on a divergence against the trade (DEV): no better than simply holding longer at any timeframe.
